premise: On the hottest day the eggs sit in the full sun while Mama Triceratops drinks at the lagoon; Spinosaurus stands beside the nest with his tall sail up to make shade, Pteranodon spots the cool patch, hops in and spreads her wings for more, and Mama comes back to cool, cosy eggs.
inspiration: The good neighbour of folk tales (the stranger who shelters the cradle), with a sail for a parasol.
lesson: Kindness doesn't wait to be asked.

en-US.title: The Sail Shade
en-US.text: {eggs:enter} {canvas:sunshine 1} It was the hottest day of the summer. {triceratops:enter} Mama Triceratops was thirsty, {triceratops:go to lagoon} so she went down to the lagoon for a drink. {sfx:lap solo} But her three eggs sat in the nest, in the hot, hot sun. {eggs:live wobble-all} Wobble, wobble, wobble. Phew! {spinosaurus:enter} Spinosaurus came walking by. {spinosaurus:face surprised} [gently] "Too hot for little ones," he said. {spinosaurus:face happy} {spinosaurus:go to eggs} So he stood beside the nest {spinosaurus:live sunbathe hold} and stretched his tall stripy sail up to the sun. Under the sail, ahh, was a patch of cool shade, just the size of a nest. {eggs:pulse} High above, {pteranodon:enter} Pteranodon spotted it. {pteranodon:face happy} "Ooh, shade!" {pteranodon:go to meadow} {sfx:flap} Down she came, {pteranodon:go to eggs by hop} and hopped in beside the nest. {pteranodon:live stretch-wings} She spread her wings, wide, wider, and made more shade. When Mama came back, {triceratops:go to eggs} she found her eggs cool and cosy, in the shade of one sail and two wings. {triceratops:face happy} [warmly] {triceratops:live nuzzle} She nuzzled them gently. {eggs:glow #FFF1C9} And Spinosaurus? [playfully] He didn't move a single scale until the day cooled down.

es-ES.title: La sombra de la vela
es-ES.text: {eggs:enter} {canvas:sunshine 1} Era el día más caluroso del verano. {triceratops:enter} Mamá Triceratops tenía sed, {triceratops:go to lagoon} así que bajó a la laguna a beber. {sfx:lap solo} Pero sus tres huevos se quedaron en el nido, al sol, con un calor… {eggs:live wobble-all} Se movieron, uno, dos y tres: ¡uf! {spinosaurus:enter} Espinosaurio pasaba por allí. {spinosaurus:face surprised} [gently] —Demasiado calor para los pequeñines —dijo. {spinosaurus:face happy} {spinosaurus:go to eggs} Así que se plantó junto al nido {spinosaurus:live sunbathe hold} y estiró su gran vela de rayas hacia el sol. Y debajo, ¡aaah!, quedó una sombra fresquita, justo del tamaño de un nido. {eggs:pulse} Desde allá arriba, {pteranodon:enter} Pteranodon la vio. {pteranodon:face happy} —¡Uy, sombra! {pteranodon:go to meadow} {sfx:flap} Bajó en un vuelo {pteranodon:go to eggs by hop} y se coló de un saltito junto al nido. {pteranodon:live stretch-wings} Abrió las alas, anchas, más anchas, e hizo más sombra. Cuando Mamá volvió, {triceratops:go to eggs} encontró sus huevos fresquitos, a la sombra de una vela y dos alas. {triceratops:face happy} [warmly] {triceratops:live nuzzle} Les dio un mimo con el hocico. {eggs:glow #FFF1C9} ¿Y Espinosaurio? [playfully] No movió ni una escama hasta que refrescó.
